status_summary: Three executive orders signed on 2025-01-20 and 2025-01-21 directed agencies to end DEI offices and equity-related grants (EO 14151), to use the term sex rather than gender and remove gender-ideology content from regulations, forms and grants (EO 14168), and to revoke the contractor equal-opportunity order and add contract and grant terms on unlawful DEI (EO 14173). Agencies have since changed regulatory text and award terms: a State Department final rule adding a foreign-assistance award term on gender ideology (effective 2026-02-26), alongside separate equity-ideology and abortion terms, an EEOC rescission of its 1979 affirmative action guidelines (2026-07-06), and a Labor Department final rule rescinding the EO 11246 regulations (published 2026-08-21, effective 2026-10-26). EO 14398 (signed 2026-03-26) added a contract clause on racially discriminatory DEI activities, to be put in place by a FAR deviation and later FAR amendment. The match stays partial: statutory text is unchanged, the abortion and reproductive-health terms are addressed only through foreign-assistance award terms, and the Fourth Circuit's 2026-02-06 ruling vacated one nationwide injunction while other challenges remain pending.

timeline.event: EO 14151 and EO 14168 signed (published 2025-01-29 and 2025-01-30). EO 14151 directs agencies to end DEI, DEIA and environmental-justice offices, positions, equity action plans and related grants and contracts within 60 days. EO 14168 defines sex as binary, directs agencies to use sex rather than gender, remove gender-ideology content from regulations, forms and communications, and not fund it, and revokes the Gender Policy Council order.

EO 14173 signed (published 2025-01-31): revokes EO 11246, requires contracts and grants to carry a term making compliance with anti-discrimination law material to payment under the False Claims Act and a certification of no unlawful DEI programs, and directs OMB to remove DEI references from acquisition and grant procedures.

State Department publishes a final rule adding a foreign-assistance award term on gender ideology (2 CFR part 603, effective 2026-02-26); the rule notes separate award terms on discriminatory equity ideology and abortion (Protecting Life in Foreign Assistance) that recipients must also accept.

In National Association of Diversity Officers in Higher Education v. Trump, the Fourth Circuit vacates the nationwide preliminary injunction against the equity-grant termination and contractor certification provisions of EOs 14151 and 14173 and remands to the District of Maryland; other challenges remain pending (per a law-firm summary).

EO 14398 signed (published 2026-03-31): agencies must put a clause in contracts and subcontracts barring racially discriminatory DEI activities and treating compliance as material under the False Claims Act; the FAR Council is to issue a deviation within 60 days and then amend the FAR. A FAR information-collection notice of 2026-05-06 describes the resulting clause 52.222-90.
EEOC publishes a final interpretive rule rescinding its 1979 Title VII affirmative action guidelines and removing them from the Code of Federal Regulations, effective 2026-07-06.
Labor Department publishes a final rule rescinding its regulations that implemented EO 11246 (41 CFR part 60), effective 2026-10-26, citing EO 14173.
